# E0303: a lens does not accept every instance of its source schema

A lens's input stands for any instance of its source schema, so the lens must
accept every one of them. An input that constrains what it takes rejects some
instances. Leave the input as `_`.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: int
			}
		}
		"1": {
			schema: {
				a: int
				b?: int
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.1->0.0": {
		input: {
			a: string
		}
		result: {
			a: input.a
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0303]: the input of lens 0.1->0.0 does not accept every instance of schema 0.1
   --> lineage.cue:19:3
    |
 19 |         input: {
    |         ^^^^^
    |
    = note: in thema's own CUE
     --> thema/lineage.cue:170:11
    = detail: field a not present in {a:int,b?:int}
              missing field "a"
    = help: a lens's input stands for any instance of its source schema; leave it as _
```
